Use case: stylized-concept, identity-preserving game sprite production.
Asset type: 8-direction transparent atlas for an original mature hand-painted/pre-rendered 2.5D dark fantasy action RPG.
Input image role: identity reference ONLY. This is Wing: an adult East Asian man with swept-up spiky black hair, very thick dark eyebrows, distinctive broad confident toothy grin, angular face and strong nose, vivid pink polo shirt and collar. Preserve these readable identifying features while making an original fantasy final boss, not an anonymous helmeted demon.
Subject: the SAME Wing in every view. Adult male, realistic full-body proportions (seven to eight heads tall), imposing black and antique-gold long executive coat over the visible pink polo collar/chest, black tailored trousers and armored boots. Two elegant dark raven-like wings OPEN BUT COMPACT behind his shoulders, contained within the cell. A golden ring of promises behind his head/shoulders. A formal staff crowned with rolled ivory documents and a small wax seal, held consistently in his RIGHT hand. Black leather, engraved dull gold, restrained magenta cloth, rich painted material detail. Uncovered human smiling face, not a skull or monster, not chibi. Intimidating executive authority, recognizability more important than horror.
CRITICAL ATLAS LAYOUT: exactly 4 columns by 2 rows. A wide 2:1 transparent sheet, preferably 2048x1024. Eight equally sized cells, one complete character per cell, each figure centered horizontally with both feet at the SAME 88% vertical baseline within that cell. All eight figures are the SAME scale. Keep the entire wing silhouette, ring, hair, staff and boots within each cell with at least 8% empty margin on EVERY side, including the top; do not enlarge individual figures to fill the sheet. Feet point according to facing. Camera is fixed at 45 degrees ABOVE the ground looking down, with a visible top-of-head and shoulder view; true isometric game viewpoint, NOT an eye-level turntable.
Exact facing sequence LEFT TO RIGHT:
Top row: SOUTH/front (nose toward screen bottom), SOUTHEAST (nose toward bottom right), EAST (RIGHT-facing full profile), NORTHEAST (back three-quarter toward top right).
Bottom row: NORTH/back (face fully hidden), NORTHWEST (back three-quarter toward top left), WEST (LEFT-facing full profile), SOUTHWEST (front three-quarter toward bottom left).
These are eight 45-degree yaw rotations of ONE identical character and equipment, not unrelated designs. Do not duplicate or mirror poses, do not swap hands, do not make left-facing sprites in the EAST column. The NORTH cell must show his back, rear of coat and wings.
TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA BACKGROUND. Absolutely no opaque background, no drawn checkerboard, no ground, base, floor, cast shadows, drop shadows, smoke, particles or ambient glow outside the compact character silhouette. No writing anywhere, no text, labels, cell outlines, logos or watermark. Original art, no franchise symbols.
